methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: McLean data center power-focused startup to be acquired for $232.28M
signals.signal_reading: A $232M acquisition of a McLean data center infrastructure startup deepens NoVA's concentrated AI/data ecosystem, reinforcing capital and capability concentration in the metro corridor while other regions remain disconnected from this value creation.

signals.title: Virginia Beach schools bring ChatGPT under division oversight as AI use grows - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach schools bringing ChatGPT under division oversight signals shallow but distributed platform adoption—educators consuming AI tools rather than building capability, creating broad but surface-level engagement across K-12.

signals.title: Norfolk could get AI assist for non-emergency calls - Yahoo
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's exploration of AI dispatch tools for non-emergency calls represents municipal adoption of turnkey AI solutions—distributed geographically but shallow in capability development, with no local workforce building the underlying systems.

signals.title: Parents call for less screen time, more intentional use of technology in schools
signals.signal_reading: Parent pushback against school technology in Southwest/Southside Virginia signals resistance to even basic digital adoption in rural regions, creating conditions where neither depth nor distribution of AI capability can take root.

signals.title: Emerald AI reaches unicorn status with $1.05B valuation - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: Emerald AI achieving unicorn status with $1.05B valuation concentrates advanced AI development capital and talent in NoVA's innovation corridor, widening the gap between metro hubs capable of deep AI work and regions consuming only platform tools.
